title: 🐔Mounts of Mayhem Expansion Launch
author: Jonathan Hill
excerpt: The **Mounts of Mayhem Rune Rush** is here! Six Tier VI surges introduce new spear enchantments, while the Valor Shop welcomes two new relics: **Messina** and **G.A.M.M.A.** This update also brings reworks to Wrath and Vainglory, a buff to Lust, and finalized descriptions of all the new and updated content.
body:
Hey everyone! The Rune Rush, new relics, and enchant updates for the Mounts of Mayhem Expansion are all now live.

Final quick overview of the changes and timeline!

  • 🕰️Tier VI surges, each starting the research for a new spear enchant, will occur at (in PST):

  • March 7, 2026 10 AM

  • March 7, 2026 3 PM

  • March 7, 2026 8 PM

  • March 8, 2026 10 AM

  • March 8, 2026 3 PM

  • March 8, 2026 8 PM

    • We expect the enchants to be found not too long after their surge is beaten, so be online if you want to witness the discovery. This won't be a multi-day discovery process like during the OG event!

  • 💎The Valor Shop contains the new relics Messina, a trident-spear hybrid, and G.A.M.M.A., a spear relic which can gather Primordial Dust.

  • 📖The Paradigms Wrath and Vainglory have been reworked, and Lust has been buffed.

  • The FAQ post has been updated with the full, final descriptions of the new relics and reworked enchants.

Hope to see you all online soon for the first event surge! 🫶
